title: Structural Silence: When AI Infrastructure Fails Speakers of Underrepresented Languages: A Case Study in Bengali, the Digital Divide, and the Hidden Cost of English-Centric Design

bias_targets.methodology: Analytic synthesis of infrastructural evidence, including calculating training token deficits (e.g., measuring a 67:1 ratio between English and Bengali in major corpora), evaluating web presence representation gaps, and comparing tokenization fertility rates between Latin and alphasyllabary scripts.

Analyzing demographic and infrastructure statistics, such as rural versus urban internet penetration rates and mobile data costs, to evaluate how cloud-dependent AI deployment architectures exclude lower-income and low-connectivity populations.
